question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"significant."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Significant" **means important or meaningful. (महत्वपूर्ण, काफ़ी बड़ा (इतना कि दीख जाए))
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
 
 
• **Example**:* The CEO's decision had a **significant**__ impact on the company's profits.*
 
 
 
• The word is often used to describe something that has a notable impact or influence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

A puzzle is a game, challenge, or toy that __tests__ one’s inventiveness or knowledge. The solver of a puzzle is supposed to __fit__ parts together logically to arrive at the correct or enjoyable solution to the challenge. Crossword puzzles, word-search puzzles, number puzzles, relational puzzles, and logic puzzles are examples of puzzle __genres__. Puzzles are frequently developed for fun purposes, but they may also result from __**significant**__ mathematical or logical challenges. In such circumstances, its answer might make an important ______ (5) ______ to mathematical research. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Servile**: overly submissive or obedient. ((अमान्‍य) ख़ुशामदी, चापलूस, दासोचित)
 
• **Subsidiary**: a company that is controlled by another company. (व्‍यापारिक कंपनी जो बड़ी कंपनी के अंतर्गत तथा उससे नियंत्रित हो; नियंत्रित कंपनी या व्‍यवसाय)
 
• **Subordinate**: lower in rank or position. (किसी के अधीन (कम शक्ति या अधिकार वाला) महत्व में किसी से कम या छोटा; अधीनस्‍थ)
